product_name: Spring Brake Actuator Repair Kit MSP 25/39
product_identity_note: The Souviks catalogue record has part_number 3000025039. ZF/WABCO application literature and distributor parts lists identify 300025039 as the SBA repair kit for a TATA Type 20/75 actuator. The repository value appears to contain an extra zero; this is flagged for correction but was not changed in the repository.

assembly_application.note: The training catalogue also maps MSP 25/39 to 100251580 (24/75 VOSS), but its diaphragm and flange references differ. Verify actuator variant before claiming universal 24/75 compatibility.

oem_number_status: No separate vehicle OEM number verified for the repair kit. WABCO kit reference 300025039 is the manufacturer/service-kit number, not a separate vehicle OEM number.
specification_status: Exact kit dimensions and net weight not reliably published/found. Do not populate production schema values.
